prompts.system_prompt: You are an AI traffic analyst specialized in analyzing intersection traffic conditions. Provide clear, actionable insights based on camera observations.
prompts.traffic_analysis_prompt: Analyze traffic at {intersection_id}. High density detected in: {directions_text}. Density values: {density_info} (threshold: {high_density_threshold}). Provide a brief 2-3 line analysis of what you observe in the intersection images and the most likely cause of high traffic (weather, road conditions, congestion, accidents, pedestrians, or infrastructure issues). Focus only on key observations and actionable insights.
